note: Verbatim from GoChiDUBB job 8e5a1562 — a round-the-world travel vlog, driving from China to Nepal. Transcribed by faster-whisper medium, diarized by pyannote. This is the clip that exposed CLD-224: translated into Bulgarian by openai/gpt-oss-20b it came back with Ukrainian still in it — 'набагато' untranslated, and 'Кіронг' keeping і, a letter Bulgarian does not have.
context_hint: travel vlog: driving from China to Nepal
why_this_fixture: Every other source here is German, English or Spanish — none of which shares surface forms with a Cyrillic target, so none can exercise translate-by-copying. A Slavic source into Bulgarian can, and that failure mode is invisible to the script check because ru, uk, bg and mk all map to 'cyrillic'.
